data.name: Book a Private Tour for Your Group!
data.headline: Customizable private walking tours in Chicago tailored to groups of any size and interest.
data.description: Inside Chicago Walking Tours offers fully customizable private walking tours designed around each group's interests, from architecture and jazz history to gangster-era Route 66 themes. No two private tours are the same: examples range from intimate day-long experiences for couples to one-hour walks for conference attendees and large corporate or family outings. Guides blend favorite downtown highlights and public route options into tailored itineraries, with pricing that decreases per person for larger groups.
data.highlights:
* Fully customizable itineraries based on group interests
* Options ranging from brief "power hour" tours to day-long private experiences
* Suitable for a wide range of group types including families, corporate groups, conferences, and special-interest themes
data.group_size: Examples given from small groups up to 120 guests

data.cancellation_notes:
###For our regular, in-person tours (i.e., NOT virtual tours and private tours):

Customers will receive a full refund or credit with at least 72 hours' notice of cancellation (i.e., you must cancel at least 3 days in advance of your tour time). Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price and will not be allowed to reschedule.
